pages.text: On its own, the Echo Pearl dropped by $(l:offsprings/singer)$(c)$(o)Singers$() is rather inert, as it even lacks the spacial abilities of a normal Ender Pearl. Its main benefit can be seen when used to enhance the abilities of a $(l:equipment/warhorn)$(c)$(o)Warhorn$() or when creating an $(l:equipment/endless_pearl)$(c)$(o)Endless Pearl$(). Otherwise, it can be disassembled into three Ender Pearls.
